<br>
1.在电脑上，用Sublime Text打开歌词文件*.lrc<br>
<img id="aimg_DdH80" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/00179894b91a31dec13.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/00179894b91a31dec13.png"><br>
<br>
2.删除开头几行<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_LeD6x" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/002d3baf036b2e03a61.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/002d3baf036b2e03a61.png"><br>
<br>
<br>
3.在Sublime Text中，“文件”--&gt;“用此编码保存”---&gt;“UTF-8 with BOM”---&gt;“关闭文件”<br>
<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_DNM66" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/0033d23c21e2fa63fd0.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/0033d23c21e2fa63fd0.png"><br>
<img id="aimg_OQ8qx" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/00437c187349feabf03.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/00437c187349feabf03.png"><br>
<br>
4.将修改后的歌词文件*.lrc，放在手机歌曲目录中即可。<br>
<br>
<img id="aimg_RGKxY" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/229dc3802dc92ced1a.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://origin.picgo.net/2026/09/29/229dc3802dc92ced1a.jpg"><br>
